home.heroTitle: A rehearsal library designed for choristers
home.heroDescription: Butterfly Studio Choral provides rehearsal recordings for every work in the catalogue. Each voice part, soprano, alto, tenor, bass, has its own tracks, so every chorister can work on their part with precision before joining the ensemble.
home.howItWorksEyebrow: How it works, at a glance
home.stepBrowseDescription: Discover our works sorted by composer and voicing.
home.stepListenDescription: Isolate each voice part to work on your voice independently.
home.stepSingDescription: Progress at your own pace, alone or with your choir.
